report_name: Microsoft Remains Top Impersonated Brand in Q3 2026 Phishing Attacks

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Link
attack_patterns.description: Used in the Anthropic/Claude impersonation campaign where fake 'payment failed' emails led victims to a phishing page to harvest credentials and payment information.

attack_patterns.name: Malicious File
attack_patterns.description: Used in the Google Antigravity impersonation campaign where developers were tricked into executing a malicious script, resulting in remote code execution.

campaigns.name: Anthropic/Claude Impersonation Campaign
campaigns.description: A phishing campaign that sent fake 'payment failed' emails to users of the Claude AI assistant, leading them to a phishing page to harvest credentials and payment information.

campaigns.name: Google Antigravity Impersonation Campaign
campaigns.description: A phishing campaign targeting developers by tricking them into running a malicious script disguised as a tool for a fictional Google 'Antigravity' platform, resulting in remote code execution.
campaigns.objective: Achieve remote code execution on developer machines

identities.name: Microsoft
identities.description: The most frequently impersonated brand in Q3 2026 phishing attacks, accounting for 33% of all attempts. Its credentials are highly valued as they can unlock access to corporate ecosystems via Microsoft 365.

identities.name: Apple
identities.description: One of the top three most impersonated brands in Q3 2026, accounting for 8% of brand phishing attempts.

identities.name: Google
identities.description: One of the top three most impersonated brands in Q3 2026, accounting for 8% of brand phishing attempts. Also impersonated in a campaign targeting developers with a fictional 'Antigravity' platform.

identities.name: Anthropic
identities.description: An AI company whose brand and product (Claude) were impersonated in a phishing campaign.

identities.name: Claude
identities.description: An AI assistant from Anthropic that was impersonated in a phishing campaign using 'payment failed' lures.

identities.name: Developers
identities.description: A class of users targeted by the Google Antigravity impersonation campaign to achieve remote code execution.

identities.name: AI Users
identities.description: A class of users targeted by the Anthropic/Claude impersonation campaign for credential and payment theft.

infrastructure.name: Anthropic/Claude Phishing Page
infrastructure.description: A phishing page designed to look like official communications from Anthropic, used to prompt victims to enter credentials and payment information.

infrastructure.name: Google Antigravity Phishing Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Infrastructure used to host and deliver a malicious script disguised as a tool for the fictional Google 'Antigravity' platform.

indicators.name: Potential Microsoft Typosquatting Domain DNS Query
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Potential Microsoft Typosquatting Domain DNS Query
id: 2b1a8c3d-4e5f-4a90-8bcd-ef1234567890
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries to a known typosquatting domain for Microsoft, often used in phishing campaigns.
references:
  - https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/10/19/check-point-brand-impersonation-scams-q3-2026-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-19
tags:
  - attack.t1566.002
level: high
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName: 'microsft.com'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects DNS queries for a typosquatted domain 'microsft.com', which is a common tactic in phishing attacks impersonating Microsoft.

indicators.name: Phishing Email with 'Payment Failed' Subject or Body
indicators.pattern:
title: Phishing Email with 'Payment Failed' Lure
id: 9c8d7e6f-5a4b-4c3d-2b1a-0f9e8d7c6b5a
status: experimental
description: Detects potential phishing emails containing the phrase 'payment failed', as seen in the Anthropic/Claude impersonation campaign.
references:
  - https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/10/19/check-point-brand-impersonation-scams-q3-2026-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-19
tags:
  - attack.t1566
level: medium
logsource:
  category: email
detection:
  selection_subject:
    Subject|contains: 'payment failed'
  selection_body:
    Body|contains: 'payment failed'
  condition: 1 of them
indicators.description: Detects emails with the 'payment failed' lure, a tactic used in the phishing campaign impersonating Anthropic's Claude AI assistant.
